findings.title: Image has no alt attribute
findings.user_impact: Screen-reader users hear the file name or nothing, and lose the information the image carries.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a meaningful alt, or alt="" when the image is purely decorative.
findings.verification: Re-run `rachnasutra accessibility`, then check the image with a screen reader.
findings.limitations: Whether the alt text is meaningful needs human review.

findings.title: Viewport meta disables or limits zoom
findings.user_impact: Low-vision users cannot pinch-zoom to read text.
findings.recommended_fix: Remove user-scalable=no and any maximum-scale below 2 from the viewport meta.
findings.verification: Pinch-zoom the page on a real device or emulator.
findings.limitations: None for the declared value.

findings.title: Button has no accessible name
findings.user_impact: Screen-reader users hear only "button" and cannot tell what it does.
findings.recommended_fix: Add visible text or an aria-label describing the action.
findings.verification: Re-run the audit; check the accessible name in the browser accessibility tree.
findings.limitations: Content injected at runtime would not be seen by static analysis.

findings.title: Form control has no programmatic label
findings.criterion: WCAG 2.2: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships, 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions, 4.1.2
findings.user_impact: Screen-reader and voice-control users cannot identify the field; a placeholder alone disappears on input.
findings.recommended_fix: Associate a visible <label for> (or wrap the control), or add aria-label when no visible label is possible.
findings.verification: Click the label to focus the field; check the accessible name in the accessibility tree.
findings.limitations: Labels supplied by a component wrapper or at runtime are not visible to a static scan.

findings.title: Click handler on non-interactive <div> without role or tabindex
findings.user_impact: Keyboard and assistive-technology users cannot reach or activate the control.
findings.recommended_fix: Use a real <button> (or <a href>); if impossible, add role, tabindex="0" and key handlers.
findings.verification: Operate the control with Tab, Enter and Space only.
findings.limitations: Delegated key handlers elsewhere are not visible to a static scan.

findings.title: Focus indicator removed (button:focus, a:focus)
findings.user_impact: Keyboard users cannot see where focus is.
findings.recommended_fix: Keep the default outline or provide a clearly visible :focus-visible style with 3:1 contrast.
findings.verification: Tab through the control and confirm a visible indicator.
findings.limitations: A replacement style in another rule or file may exist.

findings.title: Text contrast 2.32:1 is below 4.5:1 (#aaaaaa on #ffffff)
findings.user_impact: Low-vision users and anyone in bright light may be unable to read this text.
findings.recommended_fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until the ratio is at least 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text).
findings.verification: Re-run the audit; spot-check the rendered colour pair with a contrast tool.
findings.limitations: Measured from literal inline declarations. Large-text exemption is not applied to inline styles.

findings.title: Text contrast 2.85:1 is below 4.5:1 (#999999 on #ffffff)
findings.user_impact: Low-vision users and anyone in bright light may be unable to read this text.
findings.recommended_fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until the ratio is at least 4.5:1.
findings.verification: Re-run the audit; spot-check the rendered colour pair with a contrast tool.
findings.limitations: Measured from literal declarations in one rule. Cascade, opacity, gradients and images are not resolved.

findings.title: Document has no lang attribute
findings.user_impact: Screen readers may pronounce content with the wrong language rules.
findings.recommended_fix: Add lang to the <html> element, for example <html lang="en">.
findings.verification: Re-run the audit; confirm with a screen reader that pronunciation is correct.
findings.limitations: None for the missing attribute; the right language code is a content decision.

findings.title: Positive tabindex overrides natural focus order
findings.user_impact: Keyboard users tab through elements in a surprising order.
findings.recommended_fix: Use tabindex="0" or "-1" only, and fix the DOM order instead.
findings.verification: Tab through the page and confirm the order matches the visual order.
findings.limitations: None for the declared value.

findings.title: Document has no title
findings.user_impact: Users cannot tell tabs, history entries or search results apart.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a unique, descriptive <title> in <head>.
findings.verification: Re-run the audit and check the browser tab.
findings.limitations: A title may be set at runtime by a script.

findings.title: Interactive target smaller than 24x24 CSS px (.icon-btn)
findings.user_impact: Users with tremor or on touch screens may mis-tap.
findings.recommended_fix: Make the target at least 24x24 CSS px (44x44 recommended for touch) or add spacing.
findings.verification: Measure the rendered bounding box in a browser at the target viewport.
findings.limitations: Padding may enlarge the real target; selector-name match is heuristic.

findings.title: Animations or transitions exist but no prefers-reduced-motion handling
findings.criterion: WCAG 2.2: 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions (AAA, best practice)
findings.user_impact: Users with vestibular disorders may be made unwell by motion they asked the OS to reduce.
findings.recommended_fix: Wrap non-essential motion in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) or disable it under reduce.
findings.verification: Enable "reduce motion" in the OS and confirm motion stops.
findings.limitations: Motion may be handled in JavaScript; only CSS was scanned.

findings.title: Fixed width 1200px can overflow narrow viewports
findings.user_impact: On a 320px-wide screen this forces horizontal scrolling.
findings.recommended_fix: Use max-width with width: 100%, or relative units, and let content reflow.
findings.verification: Render at 320x568 and confirm no horizontal scroll.
findings.limitations: A parent container or media query may constrain the element; not rendered.

findings.title: No responsive CSS found (media/container queries, clamp, grid auto-fit, flex-wrap)
findings.user_impact: Layouts may not adapt to phones, tablets or large displays.
findings.recommended_fix: Adopt a mobile-first approach with media or container queries and fluid sizing.
findings.verification: Render at 320, 390, 768, 1024 and 1440 widths and review each screenshot.
findings.limitations: CSS frameworks (Tailwind, Bootstrap) supply responsive rules not visible in source CSS.

findings.title: Heading level skips from h1 to h3
findings.user_impact: Heading navigation implies a broken outline; users may miss that sections are related.
findings.recommended_fix: Use sequential heading levels, and style headings with CSS rather than by level.
findings.verification: Inspect the heading outline in the browser accessibility tree.
findings.limitations: Heading order across included partials is not visible to a single-file scan.

findings.title: No main landmark
findings.criterion: WCAG 2.2: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships, 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks
findings.user_impact: Keyboard and screen-reader users cannot jump straight to the primary content.
findings.recommended_fix: Wrap the primary content in <main> and add a skip link if there is repeated navigation.
findings.verification: Check landmarks with a screen-reader landmark list or the browser accessibility tree.
findings.limitations: A shared layout file may provide <main> for this page.

findings.title: Vague link text "click here"
findings.user_impact: Links listed out of context (screen-reader link lists) are indistinguishable.
findings.recommended_fix: Describe the destination in the link text, for example "Read the pricing guide".
findings.verification: Re-run the audit; review the page link list.
findings.limitations: Surrounding context may make the purpose clear to sighted users.

findings.title: Image has no explicit width and height
findings.user_impact: Late-loading images can shift layout (Cumulative Layout Shift) while the page renders.
findings.recommended_fix: Set width and height attributes (or CSS aspect-ratio) so the browser reserves space.
findings.verification: Measure CLS in a lab run (Lighthouse) before and after; compare field data if available.
findings.limitations: CSS elsewhere may already reserve the space; not measured at runtime.

findings.title: Very small text (10px)
findings.user_impact: Small text is hard to read, especially on mobile and for low-vision users.
findings.recommended_fix: Use at least 12px for supplementary text and 16px for body text; prefer rem units.
findings.verification: View on a real phone at normal distance.
findings.limitations: Context (legal footers, labels) may justify small text; this is a readability signal.

findings.title: Urgency or scarcity wording needs review
findings.user_impact: False scarcity or urgency is a dark pattern that manipulates users.
findings.recommended_fix: Confirm the claim is true and sourced from real data; otherwise remove it.
findings.verification: Human review of the data source behind the claim.
findings.limitations: Wording alone does not prove the claim is false.

coverage.detail: Source patterns and measured literal colour contrast only. Keyboard, screen-reader and axe runtime checks were not run.
Viewport meta, fixed widths and responsive CSS presence. No viewport was rendered.
Token inventory from literal CSS values; no Figma, Storybook or component API inspection.
Link text, placeholder copy and urgency wording only. No tone or localisation review.
Image dimensions and asset size only. Core Web Vitals were not measured.
Not available in this version. Requires an authorized browser audit.
Needs screenshots and a vision-capable host. No screenshot was taken.

limitations: Static analysis reads source text only. Nothing was rendered, executed or sent over a network.
Findings are review aids. Automated checks cannot establish WCAG conformance; manual testing is required.
CSS frameworks, CSS-in-JS and runtime-injected markup are only partly visible.
No numeric quality score is given because category coverage is partial.
